Stremio addon compatibility: catalog-only addons can resolve metadata from compatible providers. Manifest resource types, ID prefixes and catalog extras are respected. Live TV keeps tv/channel IDs and EPG schedules. Subtitles support video hash, ID and size, with ID-only fallback. Fixed the iOS regression test that classified Stremio live TV as an episodic series. Existing player, Torrentio, TorBox, settings and signing are preserved.
